passages.context: Chapter 7 was inspected for its twelvefold treatment of humility. Near the twelfth degree it invokes the Gospel publican's lowered gaze and self-accusation as an interior and bodily pattern under divine judgment. The Rule embeds posture within a sustained discipline of humility and does not teach that posture by itself validates prayer.
passages.notes: The Henderson transcription compresses parts of the chapter; the bounded publican passage and its immediate setting were inspected.
